marketApp.body: Post items and chat with sellers in the app. You'll get a notification when someone messages you.
marketApp.empty: Post the first item from the Misaeng app.
marketApp.railCta: Post an item in the app

market.writeIntro: Add photos and a price to show it to neighbors in your city.
market.paymentHint: Pick every method you accept. Paying after checking the item in person is safest.
market.paymentFree: Free items need no payment method.
market.zipHint: Only the ZIP code is shown, never an address. Agree on a meeting place in the inquiry chat.
market.contactWarning: Don't include phone numbers, emails or messenger IDs. They attract spam and scams. Keep the conversation in Misaeng inquiries.

safetyRules.r1: Anyone asking for money before you see the item is almost always a scammer. Zelle, Venmo and Cash App payments can't be reversed.
safetyRules.r2: Phone numbers, emails, KakaoTalk IDs, social accounts and home addresses attract spam and scams.
safetyRules.r3: Be wary if someone wants to move to text, KakaoTalk or WhatsApp, or sends outside links or payment pages.
safetyRules.r4: Anyone asking for a Google Voice, bank or email code is a scammer.
safetyRules.r5: A café, a subway station or a police Safe Exchange Zone. If it has to be at home, have someone with you.
safetyRules.r6: Check power and function, the serial number and that iCloud/Find My is removed before paying.
safetyRules.r7: Prices far below market, pressure to decide fast and requests to ship or send someone else can be scams.
safetyRules.r7Title: Too cheap or too rushed? Be wary
safetyRules.r8: Turn down fake checks, money orders, gift card payments and "I overpaid, send back the difference".
safetyRules.r9: Use the ⋯ menu. If you lose money, also report it to the police (non-emergency 311) and the FTC (reportfraud.ftc.gov).
